ideas.title: "My reaction to…" race distances
ideas.hook: My reaction to running a 5K… a 10K… a half… a full… all four in four days
ideas.how: Start flat-faced on the smallest distance, get more unhinged with each bigger one. 3–5 rounds, under 20 seconds. Built for challenge weekends.

ideas.title: "Be OK" relatable dance
ideas.hook: me at mile 11 insisting I'm totally fine
ideas.how: Bouncy waist-up dance in the corral, then on-screen text with the specific, slightly embarrassing truth ("I have eaten 4 gels and a churro").

ideas.title: Defend an unreasonable running opinion
ideas.hook: Character stops ARE speed work and I will not be taking questions
ideas.how: Deadpan lip-sync straight to camera while text states your hot take. Film it in costume for extra commitment.

ideas.title: Slow-mo corral entrances
ideas.hook: 4 a.m. at a theme park hits different
ideas.sound: The Weeknd & Kendrick Lamar – "Pray For Me"
ideas.how: Each person in your group takes a turn walking into the same frame in exaggerated slow motion, in full costume, under the start-line lights.

ideas.title: Fan transition into race costume
ideas.hook: hotel pajamas → race costume in one spin
ideas.how: Overhead or straight-on shot, cover the lens with a hand or fan, land in full costume with bib pinned. Test it the night before so race morning is one take.

ideas.title: Cinematic finish-line edit
ideas.hook: (no text until the last beat) …and then I finished
ideas.how: 5–8 clips: alarm, corral, castle, mile marker, the hard part, finish arch. Land the medal moment exactly on the song's final beat. White caption only at the end.

ideas.title: "The outfit / the miles that paid for it"
ideas.hook: the outfit vs. the 400 training miles that paid for it
ideas.how: First half: costume strut. Second half: quick cuts of dark early runs, treadmill, ice baths, sewing the costume at 1 a.m.

ideas.title: Runway hip pop medal reveal
ideas.hook: walking out of the finish chute like it's fashion week
ideas.how: Recreate the hesitant runway turn and hip pop toward the camera, then flip the medal(s) on the beat.

ideas.title: "Message from A" running habits
ideas.hook: You thought you could carb-load on churros? Mile 9 remembers. –A
ideas.sound: Original audio or the "-A" text sound (check in-app)
ideas.how: Film yourself doing a slightly embarrassing race-week habit, overlay a one-line note that ends with "–A." 7–15 seconds; make a few and drop them across the week.

ideas.title: "wtf is a rest day"
ideas.hook: wtf is a rest day
ideas.how: Text: "wtf is…" + something you don't relate to. Then flat-faced b-roll of you doing the opposite: strength, long run, Dopey sim weekend.

ideas.title: Answer in one word: race weekend edition
ideas.hook: My running buddy describes each race in ONE word
ideas.sound: None (text-based) or a soft trending instrumental
ideas.how: Ask your partner or friends for one word per race / mile / character stop and show the replies. Funniest when they're brutally honest.

ideas.title: "2026 is the new 2016" race throwback
ideas.hook: My first runDisney weekend vs. this one
ideas.how: Old oversaturated race photos with puppy-filter energy, then this season's kit. Works best if you've been doing these races for years.

ideas.title: Race weekend photo dump carousel
ideas.hook: Photo dump: the medals, the blisters, the snacks
ideas.how: 8–10 photos, mix polished and chaotic: corral selfie, blurry course shot, snack haul, medal flat lay, swollen feet. Post 1–3 days after.

ideas.title: Gift guide for the runner who has everything
ideas.hook: Things runners actually want (that aren't another water bottle)
ideas.how: Quick cuts of 5–7 items you actually use. Early-Christmas content starts climbing in November.

ideas.title: Black Friday honest review: race gear
ideas.hook: Running gear that's worth it vs. what not to buy
ideas.how: Two piles, quick verdicts. Honest-review content peaks the week before Black Friday (Nov 27).

ideas.title: Low-angle costume walk reveal
ideas.hook: I sewed my race costume. Watch it survive 13.1 miles.
ideas.sound: Any strut/reveal sound (Ramalama walk still works)
ideas.how: Phone low on the ground, walk toward it showing just shoes and legs, pull back on the beat to reveal the full costume and bib. One per race.

ideas.title: Night-before flat lay
ideas.hook: Everything I'm wearing and carrying for tomorrow's race
ideas.sound: ASMR original audio or a calm trending sound
ideas.how: Top-down shot, add one item per beat: bib, shoes, costume pieces, gels, ears. Ends with the bag zipped and labeled.

ideas.title: 3 a.m. alarm to start line
ideas.hook: POV: your alarm is set for 2:45 a.m. on vacation
ideas.how: Alarm, coffee, costume, bus, security, corral, fireworks. 1–2 seconds per clip.

ideas.title: Every character stop, ranked
ideas.hook: I stopped for every character so you don't have to
ideas.how: Grab a 2-second clip at each stop with the line length on screen. Rank them in the voiceover afterward.

ideas.title: Face-only food ranking
ideas.hook: Rating park snacks with my face only (post-race edition)
ideas.how: Bite, react, next. Easy to film between booths or snack carts; works again for ranking the transportation.

ideas.title: Medal stack weigh-in
ideas.hook: How much do challenge medals actually weigh?
ideas.how: Put each medal on a kitchen or luggage scale one at a time. Finish with them all around your neck.

ideas.title: The math of a challenge weekend
ideas.hook: 48.6 miles, 4 mornings, 1 alarm I hate
ideas.how: Talk through total miles, wake-up times, calories, and how many outfits you packed while showing your packing list on screen.

ideas.title: Altitude runner meets Florida humidity
ideas.hook: I train at altitude. Florida humidity said no.
ideas.how: Shakeout run with your watch pace and heart rate on screen, then your face. Only works if you really do train high, but it's a great hook if you do.

ideas.title: Couples or friends costume duo
ideas.hook: We matched. He didn't know until this morning.
ideas.how: Split-screen or back-to-back reveal of two coordinating costumes. Best when the race theme has a pair (Chip 'n' Dale, Mickey & Minnie).

ideas.title: Expo day GRWM
ideas.hook: GRWM for the race expo (my wallet is scared)
ideas.how: Get ready while talking through what you're hoping to buy, then cut to the haul at the end.

ideas.title: Resort transportation tier list
ideas.hook: Ranking every way to get around, from a runner's legs
ideas.how: Clip of each ride type with a tier label; bonus points for ranking how each one feels after a long race.

ideas.title: Post-race party GRWM
ideas.hook: GRWM for the post-race party with legs that don't work
ideas.how: Compression socks under the outfit, ice pack on the knee, medal as the accessory. Cut to the party.

ideas.title: Pack with me: race weekend edition
ideas.hook: Packing for a 4-race weekend in a carry-on
ideas.how: Show race bags labeled by day, what goes in the carry-on vs. checked, and the one thing you always forget.

ideas.title: Wear the medals through the airport
ideas.hook: Security asked about the medals again
ideas.how: Medals on, walking to the gate, strangers' reactions. Classic for the trip home.

ideas.title: Mile-by-mile recap
ideas.hook: Every mile of the half in 60 seconds
ideas.how: One 3–5 second clip per mile with the mile number on screen. Long-form version for YouTube.

ideas.title: Every outfit I wore this weekend
ideas.hook: All 9 outfits from one race weekend (yes I counted)
ideas.how: Same mirror, cut on the beat between each outfit you planned in the app. Credit any handmade pieces.

ideas.title: 3 things I'd do differently
ideas.hook: 3 things I'd never do again at a challenge weekend
ideas.how: Fast, honest list with b-roll. Comments fill up with people's own lessons, which helps reach.

ideas.title: How I made the race costume
ideas.hook: This costume ran 13.1 miles. Here's how I made it.
ideas.how: Fabric choice, the pattern, what held up and what chafed. Ties running and making together.
